Receiving delayed product assays: P = 0.022 (t=59), 0.026 (t=119), 1.117 (t=179), 2.912 (t=239) g/L

args.rationale: Receiving DO2 is consistently far above the 2 mg/L hard constraint (latest 10.33 mg/L at t=52 h; minimum observed ~8.17 mg/L), and product assays track the source-calibrated trajectory within batch noise (P=2.912 g/L at t=239 h vs sources 2.98–3.06 g/L). This appears to be a normal case: no oxygen-constraint risk exists, and any feed reduction or stop would sacrifice product mass without any needed benefit. KEEP retains full production and satisfies the constraint.
args.uncertainty: Receiving process could deviate from source dynamics later in the run (hidden parameters unavailable), and future DO2/product outcomes are not observed. However, the ~5x margin above the DO limit and on-trend product growth make a constraint violation under KEEP unlikely; monitoring should continue.
